sources.locator: "Arab Revolt", revision 1370428832, § Sharif Hussein of Mecca

explanation: The revolt’s article makes the revolution the reason its leader held the office he raised it from: Hussein was made Emir of Mecca in its aftermath. The article reads: "In 1908, in the aftermath of the Young Turk Revolution, he was appointed Emir of Mecca by the Ottoman sultan Abdul Hamid II."
